_note: REAL VERIFIED DATA — official State Channelizing Agencies (SCAs), sourced directly from the PDF published at https://nsfdc.nic.in/our-channel-partners on 2026-09-04. These are the actual apex state-level bodies that route NSFDC loan applications — not fictional partners. latitude/longitude are intentionally NULL: NSFDC does not publish coordinates, and geocoding was not done here to avoid introducing inaccurate/guessed positions. Coordinates should be generated separately via a proper geocoding API against the address field, then reviewed before treating them as accurate.
partner_type_note: All entries below are 'State Channelizing Agency (SCA)' — the apex state body for that state/UT, not a specific branch or NBFC. NSFDC also has separate channel partner categories (Public Sector Banks, Regional Rural Banks, NBFC-MFIs, Cooperative Banks, Small Finance Banks, SIDBI, Cooperative Societies) each published as their own PDF list at the same source URL — not yet transcribed into this seed file.
source_document: NSFDC 'STATE/UT-WISE LIST OF STATE CHANNELISING AGENCIES' PDF
supported_schemes_note: SCAs generically channelize all NSFDC credit-linked schemes for their state (MFS, Term Loan, Aajeevika MFY, UNY, ELS) unless a specific SCA states otherwise — this is an inference from NSFDC's general channelization model, not an explicit per-partner scheme list, so mark supported_schemes as 'all_nsfdc_schemes' rather than fabricating a specific subset per partner.
